🚨🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM’S GRITO: MEXICO IS NO ONE’S COLONY OR PROTECTORATE</u>

On the 216th anniversary of independence, before 300,000 people in the Zócalo, President Sheinbaum led her second Grito and added new arengas for Indigenous peoples, Afro-Mexicans and migrants, closing with “¡Viva México libre, independiente y soberano!” — days after declaring that Mexico “is not and will not be a colony or protectorate of any foreign country.”

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>MEXICO EATS THE OIL SHOCK SO DRIVERS DON’T</u>

As Brent tops $105 amid the US–Iran war, Hacienda reactivated an extra diesel subsidy for the first time since 2022 — covering 100% of the 7.36-peso IEPS plus 15 centavos per liter (Sept 12–18) and lifting Magna gasoline support from 31.45% to 51.43%. El Economista reports the state is absorbing the global price spike to keep pump prices flat and inflation (3.26%) contained — the opposite of a gasolinazo.
banner: MEXICO ABSORBS OIL SHOCK, NO GASOLINAZO

🇲🇽🏭 <u>MEXICO BUILDS ITS OWN CHIP INDUSTRY ON THE US BORDER</u>

Baja California — home to 127+ advanced-electronics firms and decades of export manufacturing — launched two programs backing 5 new startups and 10 local suppliers across Mexicali, Tijuana, Ensenada and Tecate, with six months of training and partnerships alongside Qualcomm, Skyworks, Infineon and Synopsys. Gov. Marina del Pilar is building a homegrown semiconductor chain on the same border Washington wants to militarize.
banner: MEXICO BUILDS ITS OWN CHIP CHAIN

text:
🔥🇲🇽 <u>INFONAVIT CHIEF: MEDIA WAGING “PERVERSE CAMPAIGN”</u>

Infonavit director Octavio Romero denounced a “perverse campaign” by private media inventing that he out-earns the president and hides luxury assets. The receipts: his 2025 gross pay was 188,499 pesos a month — 3,346 below Sheinbaum’s 191,846 — his Tabasco ranch bought 42 years ago, his Tlalpan home 25 years ago on a bank loan. The smear lands as his agency drives Vivienda para el Bienestar toward 12 million families.

⚖️🇲🇽 <u>MEXICO’S RIGHTS COMMISSION SLASHES ITS OWN BUDGET</u>

The CNDH — once a bloated haven of neoliberal privilege — proposed cutting its own 2027 budget by 168.9 million pesos, a 9.28% nominal drop (about 12–13% in real terms) to 1,650.8 mdp, trimming bureaucracy to steer more toward actual rights defense. Its payroll has already fallen from 1,926 people in 2019 to under 1,500.

🇲🇽💵 <u>MEXICO TAGS EVERY REMITTANCE TO GUARD ITS LIFELINE</u>

Banco de México now marks remittances inside its SPEI interbank system, tracing each transfer’s origin and destination so banks can flag illicit flows — a shield built as Washington brands Mexican money “narco cash” and floats taxing transfers. The tool, live since March 2024, separates inbound dollars converted to pesos from outbound sends, protecting a flow worth over $64 billion a year to millions of families.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM: “ABSURD” TO CLAIM MEXICO WANTS US TROOPS</u>

A viral X “poll” by businessman Simón Levy — amplified by ex-DEA chief Derek Maltz and the network NewsNation — claimed Mexicans overwhelmingly want US special forces to hunt “corrupt politicians” on Mexican soil. Sheinbaum called it absurd: nearly 90% of Mexicans oppose any foreign intervention, “because of our history, our nationalist sense, and the pride of being Mexican.”

🇲🇽✊ "They turned rights into privileges. We recovered the essence that the people have rights." "We consider housing, education, health, and the pension for older adults a right of the people of Mexico — and we are advancing in access to those rights." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on housing as a right Her housing report: about 12 million families reached, 667,000 homes contracted, 277,000 under construction. Health centers that once charged fees are now free.
banner: HOUSING: A RIGHT, NOT A PRIVILEGE
